Initial release of AI-powered flowering and fruit-set rate analysis for tomato and chili plants.

- Automatically detects and counts open flowers and young fruits from user images or videos using object detection.
- Calculates fruit-set rate (young fruits / flowers × 100%) and evaluates pollination and plant health.
- Provides actionable suggestions for pollination or fertilization adjustments based on analysis results.
- Strict open-id flow control for report access and cloud queries—prevents using default or assumed ids.
- Automatically generates and outputs historical analysis reports as Markdown tables with clickable report links.
- Supports multiple use cases: home grow-boxes, greenhouses, and balcony vegetable gardens.
